mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_latest AS ( SELECT father_id, bom_ver, data_status FROM ( SELECT father_id, bom_ver, data_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY father_id ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bom_ver, '_V', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) DESC ) AS rn FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` WHERE data_status = '已审核' AND TRIM(son_no) = '1' ) x WHERE rn = 1 ), bom_tree AS ( SELECT 0 AS level_no, TRIM(t.`son_no`) AS son_no, t.`bom_id` AS bom_id, t.`father_id` AS father_id, (SELECT m.material_name FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`father_id` LIMIT 1) AS father_name, TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS current_code, (SELECT m.material_name FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`father_id` LIMIT 1) AS current_name, TRIM(t.`son_id`) AS son_id, t.`s_material_name` AS son_name, TRIM(t.`unit`) AS unit, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`fenzi`), ''), '1') AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS fenzi, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`fenmu`), ''), '1') AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS fenmu, CAST(TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS CHAR(1000)) AS path, CAST(CONCAT(TRIM(t.`father_id`), '#1') AS CHAR(2000)) AS cycle_key, t.`bom_ver` AS bom_ver, CAST(CONCAT('1-', LPAD(TRIM(t.`son_no`), 2, '0')) AS CHAR(50)) AS `展开项次`, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`fenzi`), ''), '1') / COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`fenmu`), ''), '1') AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS cum_qty_raw, CAST( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`fenzi`), ''), '1') / COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`fenmu`), ''), '1') * (1 + COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.`loss_rate`), ''), NULLIF( (SELECT loss_rate FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`son_id` LIMIT 1), ''), #{defaultLossRate} ) / 100) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS cum_qty_loss, -- 锚定行 cum_qty_loss 后面加这两行（跟递归行保持一致）： CAST(COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.`lead_time`), ''), (SELECT lead_time FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`son_id` LIMIT 1), 0 ) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS node_lead_time, CAST(COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.`sub_cost`), ''), (SELECT sub_cost FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`son_id` LIMIT 1), 0 ) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS node_sub_cost FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` t JOIN bom_latest l ON t.`father_id` = l.`father_id` AND t.`bom_ver` = l.`bom_ver` WHERE t.`father_id` = #{fatherId} AND t.`data_status` = '已审核'
UNION ALL
SELECT b.level_no + 1, TRIM(t.`son_no`) AS son_no, t.`bom_id` AS bom_id, t.`father_id` AS father_id, b.current_name AS father_name, TRIM(t.`father_id`) AS current_code, t.`s_material_name` AS current_name, TRIM(t.`son_id`) AS son_id, t.`s_material_name` AS son_name, TRIM(t.`unit`) AS unit, CAST(COALESCE(t.`fenzi`, 0) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS fenzi, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.`fenmu`, 0), 1) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS fenmu, CAST(CONCAT(b.path, ' -> ', TRIM(t.`son_id`)) AS CHAR(1000)) AS path, CAST(CONCAT(b.cycle_key, '|', TRIM(t.`son_id`), '#', TRIM(t.`son_no`)) AS CHAR(2000)) AS cycle_key, t.`bom_ver` AS bom_ver, CAST(CONCAT(b.`展开项次`, '_', LPAD(TRIM(t.`son_no`), 2, '0')) AS CHAR(50)) AS `展开项次`, CAST( b.cum_qty_raw * (COALESCE(t.`fenzi`, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(t.`fenmu`, 0), 1)) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS cum_qty_raw, -- 修正：递归行损耗逻辑对齐锚定行，三级回退 CAST( b.cum_qty_loss * (COALESCE(t.`fenzi`, 0) / COALESCE(NULLIF(t.`fenmu`, 0), 1)) * (1 + COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.`loss_rate`), ''), NULLIF( (SELECT loss_rate FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`son_id` LIMIT 1), ''), #{defaultLossRate} ) / 100) AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS cum_qty_loss, -- 新增：提前期 CAST( COALESCE(b.node_lead_time, 0) + COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.`lead_time`), ''), (SELECT COALESCE(lead_time, 0) FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`son_id` LIMIT 1), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS node_lead_time, -- 新增：本节点费用 CAST(COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.`sub_cost`), ''), (SELECT sub_cost FROM `清洗_物料主数据` m WHERE m.material_id = t.`son_id` LIMIT 1), 0 ) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS node_sub_cost FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` t JOIN bom_tree b ON TRIM(t.`father_id`) = TRIM(b.son_id) JOIN bom_latest l ON t.`father_id` = l.`father_id` AND t.`bom_ver` = l.`bom_ver` WHERE b.level_no < 10 AND b.cycle_key NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(t.`son_id`), '#', TRIM(t.`son_no`), '%') AND TRIM(t.`son_id`) <> '' AND t.`data_status` = '已审核' ) SELECT bt.bom_id AS bomMid, bt.father_id AS `父项物料编码`, bt.father_name AS `父项物料名称`, bt.level_no + 1 AS `层级`, bt.`展开项次` AS `展开项次`, CAST(bt.son_no AS UNSIGNED) AS `子项项次`, bt.son_id AS `子项物料编码`, bt.son_name AS `子项物料名称`, m.parameter AS `规格型号`, bt.unit AS `单位`, bt.fenzi AS `用量分子`, bt.fenmu AS `用量分母`, ROUND(bt.cum_qty_raw * #{orderQty}, 6) AS `无损耗数量`, ROUND(bt.cum_qty_loss * #{orderQty}, 6) AS `含损耗数量`, CASE WHEN m.is_buy = '是' THEN '外购' WHEN m.is_out = '是' THEN '委外' ELSE '自制' END AS `子项物料属性`, -- 新增输出 CAST(COALESCE(bt.node_lead_time, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS leadTime, CAST(bt.node_sub_cost * bt.cum_qty_loss AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS nodeCost, bt.cum_qty_raw AS cum_qty_raw, bt.bom_ver AS `bomVer`
FROM bom_tree bt
LEFT JOIN `清洗_物料主数据` m ON bt.son_id = m.material_id WHERE bt.son_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bt.level_no, CAST(bt.son_no AS UNSIGNED), bt.current_code
mapper.update: UPDATE `清洗_物料清单主数据` SET is_valid = 0 WHERE bom_id = #{bomId}
UPDATE `清洗_物料清单主数据` SET is_valid = 1 WHERE bom_id = #{bomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `清洗_物料清单主数据` ( bom_id, father_id, son_id, son_no, bom_ver, fenzi, fenmu, loss_rate, lead_time, sub_cost, unit, data_status, is_valid ) VALUES ( #{bomId}, #{fatherId}, #{sonId}, #{sonNo}, #{bomVer}, #{fenzi}, #{fenmu}, #{lossRate}, #{leadTime}, #{nodeCost}, #{unit}, #{dataStatus}, 1 )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `清洗_物料清单主数据` WHERE bom_id = #{bomId}
